          UPGRADE_ACCOUNT_STATISTICS_ASSISTANT: ${{ inputs.upgrade_account_statistics_assistant }}
          UPGRADE_SOURCE_PRODUCER: ${{ inputs.upgrade_source_producer }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch"
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/main"
          if test "$UPGRADE_SOURCE_PRODUCER" = true; then
            test "$UPGRADE_ACCOUNT_STATISTICS_ASSISTANT" != true
            test "$UPGRADE_EXISTING_OWNER_EXPORT" != true
            test "$UPGRADE_ACCOUNT_ASSISTANT" != true
            test "$UPGRADE_STATISTICS_REVISION" != true
            test "$UPGRADE_ESTABLISHED_NATIVE_CURRENT_ORIGIN" != true
            test "$UPGRADE_LAST_MILE_ENCLOSURE" != true
            test "$RESTART_ARCHIVED_WEATHER" != true
            test "$SAVED_WEATHER" != true
            test -z "$RECOVER_PUBLIC_RUN_ID"
            test "$RECOVER_PUBLIC_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
            test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
            test "$CONFIRMATION" = DEPLOY-CODE-ONLY-REPAIR
          fi
          if test "$UPGRADE_ACCOUNT_STATISTICS_ASSISTANT" = true; then
            test "$UPGRADE_EXISTING_OWNER_EXPORT" != true
            test "$UPGRADE_ACCOUNT_ASSISTANT" != true

required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      upgrade_source_producer:
        description: "Installer kun den udstedte SOURCE-kompatibilitetsbinding fra autentiske585-originaler; SOURCE19-producenten forbliver OFF"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      restart_archived_weather:
        description: "Ny fremadrettet familie fra særskilt arkiverede originaler og gemte PART-input; ingen leverandørhentning"
        required: false
edits.original:
required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
